description: This file contains implementation details for listing and traversing objects within a Git repository, including functions to process trees, blobs, commits, tags, and manage traversal context and filters.

classes.name: traversal_context
classes.description: Structure holding context for traversing repository objects, including references to revision info, callback functions for showing objects and commits, filters, and traversal state.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Calls the user-defined function to display a commit if such a callback is set.

methods.name: void show_object(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct object * object,const char * name)
methods.description: Calls the user-defined function to display an object if such a callback is set, with additional filtering for already unpacked objects.

methods.name: void process_blob(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct blob * blob,struct strbuf * path,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a blob object, applying filters and possibly displaying it.

methods.name: void process_tree_contents(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Iterates over the entries in a tree, processing each sub-tree or blob appropriately.

methods.name: void process_tree(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a tree object, including parsing, filtering, displaying, and recursive traversal of its contents.

methods.name: void process_tag(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tag * tag,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a tag object, applying filters and displaying it.

methods.name: void mark_edge_parents_uninteresting(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge)
methods.description: Marks parent commits as uninteresting and optionally shows edges.

methods.name: void add_edge_parents(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Adds parent commits' tree objects to a set and marks uninteresting parents.

methods.name: void mark_edges_uninteresting(struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,int sparse)
methods.description: Marks commit edges as uninteresting based on provided criteria and optionally shows edges.

methods.name: void add_pending_tree(struct rev_info * revs,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Adds a tree object to the pending list for processing.

methods.name: void traverse_non_commits(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Processes non-commit objects such as trees, blobs, and tags pending in the traversal context.

methods.name: void do_traverse(struct traversal_context * ctx)
methods.description: Performs the core traversal over commits and associated objects, applying filters and callbacks.

methods.name: void traverse_commit_list_filtered(struct rev_info * revs,show_commit_fn show_commit,show_object_fn show_object,void * show_data,struct oidset * omitted)
methods.description: Public API function that initiates traversal of a commit list with filtering, and callbacks for displaying commits and objects.
